sample-mars-astronaut.title: Cinematic Astronaut Exploring Mars
sample-mars-astronaut.prompt: A cinematic astronaut exploring Mars, duration 15 seconds, 16:9 widescreen cinematic style.

clips.title: Scene 1: Descent onto Red Dunes
clips.sceneDescription: Camera tracks solitary astronaut boots landing on red Martian dust dunes with solar lens flare.
clips.prompt: A solitary astronaut in an advanced white spacesuit walking on the red sand dunes of Mars, dramatic dust storm on the horizon, golden sun flare, photorealistic IMAX documentary style. Scene 1 - Establish environment. Camera: Wide establishing shot, slow ambient push-in.
clips.continuityPrompt: Style: cinematic, Aspect Ratio: 16:9. Consistent Martian atmospheric haze and copper horizon.
clips.cameraMovement: Wide establishing shot, slow ambient push-in

clips.title: Scene 2: Atmospheric Scanner Interaction
clips.sceneDescription: Astronaut activates wrist-mounted sensor beam scanning rocky crater formations.
clips.prompt: Astronaut inspecting high-tech holographic scanning device over Martian rock crevices, red soil kicking up in the wind. Camera: Medium tracking shot following central action, smooth dolly.
clips.continuityPrompt: Style: cinematic, Aspect Ratio: 16:9. Consistent Martian atmospheric haze and copper horizon.
clips.cameraMovement: Medium tracking shot following central action, smooth dolly

clips.title: Scene 3: Horizon Reveal at Sunset
clips.sceneDescription: Astronaut reaches ridge crest overlooking vast canyon under twin moons.
clips.prompt: Epic wide panorama of astronaut standing on high Martian cliff overlooking Olympus Mons basin during blue sunset. Camera: Steady forward tracking with shallow depth of field.
clips.continuityPrompt: Style: cinematic, Aspect Ratio: 16:9. Consistent Martian atmospheric haze and copper horizon.
clips.cameraMovement: Steady forward tracking with shallow depth of field
